## Added
- First start asks where songs may come from: local, YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify, SoundCloud, Deezer, files. Change it any time under Settings → Sources
- Import playlists by link (Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Deezer) or file (Exportify CSV, M3U, TXT). Every song is matched against your library; matches play locally, the rest through the platform's official player
- Spotify sign-in (PKCE or pasted token), your playlists and liked songs, playback with the Web Playback SDK or Spotify Connect
- Share songs, albums and playlists by link like on Spotify. The share page plays right away, even without an account
- Save shared playlists into your own library with one tap; imports can also be saved as normal playlists
- 10-band equalizer with presets and preamp (browser and desktop via WebAudio, Android via the system equalizer)
- Lyrics from the file's tags or LRCLIB, synced lines follow the song and can be tapped to jump there
- Platform songs in search, source badges in every list, guide in `docs/plattformen.md`

## Fixed
- Android: share links open the system share sheet, Spotify sign-in stays inside the app

## Install
- **Update server (Proxmox node shell):** `bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Labtoso/Musik/main/deploy/proxmox.sh)"`
- **Update server (Debian / Ubuntu):** `musik-update`
- **Android:** install the new `Musik.apk` over the old one
- **Windows:** run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
- **Spotify:** see `docs/plattformen.md` for the developer app and redirect address
